# BrowseJobs

> IBrowseJobs Technologies, Whitefield, Bengaluru. Data Engineering, DevOps & Cloud, Python Backend and Data Analytics courses, plus an AI interview product for employers. The syllabus is reverse-engineered from real interviews. Nobody can guarantee employment — the market decides.

## Courses

- [Data Engineering course](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/data-engineering): Pipelines, warehouses, and the modern data stack. Pay after you're hired — the placement fee is due only after an offer is accepted.
- [DevOps & Cloud](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/devops-cloud): Ship, scale, and run production systems.
- [Python Backend](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/python-backend): APIs, databases, and production Python.
- [Data Analytics](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/data-analytics): SQL, dashboards, and decisions from data.
- [All courses](https://browsejobs.ai/courses)

## Hiring product

- [AI interviews for employers](https://browsejobs.ai/employers): Structure a job description, rank candidates, run AI screening and interview rounds, and hand HR a written brief.
- [Open jobs](https://browsejobs.ai/jobs): Roles hiring through BrowseJobs, plus openings from the wider market.

## Fees

Three free steps come first: counselling with a written Career Analysis Report, a live masterclass, and a 7-hour Python bootcamp. Registration is ₹30,000 after those steps, or 3 × ₹10,000. The placement fee is the first 3 months' CTC, due only after the student accepts an offer, paid as 6 monthly EMIs, with the ₹30,000 adjusted inside it. 30-day money-back guarantee, any reason, in writing.

## Answers

Short pages written so an answer can be quoted. Each one starts with the answer.

- [Answers](https://browsejobs.ai/answers): Hub of the direct answers below.
- [Best data engineering course in India](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/best-data-engineering-course-in-india): No fake ranking. How to choose, and what the six-month live online course actually is.
- [How can a non-IT person become a data engineer](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/how-can-a-non-it-person-become-a-data-engineer): Free AI interview, then a score, then a course only if you still need one.
- [AI interview platform for hiring in India](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/ai-interview-platform-for-hiring-in-india): Disclosed screening call, proctored rounds, written brief. A person releases the offer.
- [AI hiring tool to shortlist candidates automatically](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/ai-hiring-tool-to-shortlist-candidates-automatically): Ranked shortlist with a written reason. Rules you set can move someone forward. The tool does not reject or hire on its own.
- [Best data engineering course in Bangalore](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/best-data-engineering-course-in-bangalore): How to choose in Bengaluru. Live online course, Whitefield office, fees in writing.
- [Is pay after placement real?](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/is-pay-after-placement-real): ₹30,000 registration after three free steps. Placement fee only after an accepted offer.
- [What is an AI interview, and how does the score work?](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/what-is-an-ai-interview): 15 questions from your CV, a score out of 100, and when employers can see your profile.
- [How long does it take to become a data engineer?](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/how-long-to-become-a-data-engineer): The course is six months. That is not a hire date.
